metadata.description: A harness for Claude Code agents: isolated workspaces, a Bash guard, writing skills.

plugins.name: hi
plugins.description: Workspaces over Orca or git worktrees, set up per tree (gortex when installed), repo setup.

plugins.name: hi-guard
plugins.description: A Bash PreToolUse guard: sudo and configured deny patterns, with checks other plugins can add.

plugins.name: hi-docs
plugins.description: Write documents teammates read in short sittings, and test them on a fresh reader.

plugins.name: hi-crew
plugins.description: Ticket workers on Orca: start a worker on a ticket in its own workspace, and a digest of what the workers wait on you for.
